title: Independently curated bilingual holdout for content, grounding, and continuity
description: Six previously unused cases: two original text families plus one original five-target visual scene, each in Chinese and English, with three stages per case. Controlled replays validate offline plumbing; they are not real model outputs or quality scores.
limitations: A six-case holdout with three content families is a small regression sample, not a statistical model ranking.
Chinese and English image cases share one scene; they are not two independent visual scenes.
Five unequal, irregularly placed targets and partial occlusion broaden geometry coverage but do not establish natural-photo performance.
Controlled replay is contributor-authored and must never be represented as live-model quality evidence.
Do not expose review anchors, geometry records, replays, or authoring code to generation. Freeze model and implementation candidates before inspecting holdout inputs.
